artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: substrate(security_key, client=None) returns {security_key, prior_reports, continuation, sector_template, fund_form, typecast} -- prior_reports is a direct, always-fresh typed.reports_for() read ({bronze_key, sha256, period, class} per report, no bytes served); each of the four derived members is {uri, content_sha256, method_version, inputs_count, current} via the ONE stored-object picker _pick_stored (matches the module's own current_inputs() when a match exists, else the lexicographically-last stored object with current False, else {absent: reason}). sector_template is resolved via sector_template.business_type_of_security (not business_type_of -- row AMGT_CORPUS-Z-W1-S2); fund_form via the continuation artifact's own fund_of_record. --first-covered calls substrate() once for the security key continuation._resolved_security_keys/read_latest would pick (same algorithm, reused via _pick_first_covered_security_key). --difference-arm mirrors the live typed-silver/research-report-extract/four-gold-table prefixes (GET/LIST only) into an in-memory StubS3Client, calls substrate() (call 1), adds ONE synthetic OTHER-class non-xlsx report to the stub via typed.record()+store.silver_append()+store.bronze_put() (stub-only, no live S3 write of any kind), re-derives ONLY continuation on the stub (continuation.write_one), calls substrate() again (call 2), and reports changed_set vs expected_changed_set=[continuation, prior_reports].

6 offline tests under the poison, every object seeded through the package's own writers (store.bronze_put/store.silver_append/continuation.write_one/sector_template._run_write) against substrate.StubS3Client: ONE CALL FIVE MEMBERS (all 5 keys present); ABSENT IS NAMED (a security with no XLSX record resolves sector_template to {absent: ...} while a REAL 'healthcare' sector_template artifact for a DIFFERENT security lives in the same store and is not leaked into the absent reason, and is itself reachable); CURRENT FLIPS (adding a second report without re-deriving continuation flips continuation.current from True to False while the still-picked object's content_sha256 is unchanged, and the three artifacts with nothing to move stay absent both times); THE DIFFERENCE ARM CAN FAIL (run_difference_arm(..., redrive=False) leaves continuation out of changed_set, so difference_ok is False) and its positive twin (redrive=True gives changed_set == expected_changed_set, difference_ok True); a poison positive control. A module-level pyarrow warm-up (pa.Table.from_pylist at import time, before conftest's autouse poison fixture runs) avoids a real per-device artifact: pyarrow's first-ever from_pylist call lazily imports pandas, which calls platform.win32_ver() -> subprocess.run(['ver']) once on this device -- warming it at collection time keeps every later from_pylist call (inside a poisoned test, via store.silver_append) off subprocess.
